summary: All 11 acceptance criteria (AC1-AC10 + AC8b) verified present, faithful, and acceptance-test-aligned against the diff. poFeedback PATCH (write/echo/trim, works started, clears via ""/null, exact 400 invalid_po_feedback with pinned detail string, non-string rejection) all confirmed in patch.ts + helpers.ts + routes.lead-fields-tag-filter.test.ts. leadParentTaskId POST (persist+round-trip, empty-string soft-drop, poFeedback never creatable) confirmed in create.ts/sdk-sessions-store.ts + the surgically-reduced routes.test.ts regression. ?tag= filter (exact case-sensitive match, unknown-tag 200-empty, empty-value no-op, projectId intersection, repeated-param first-wins, filter applied before findManyByUuid — verified via real-SessionWatcher spy and confirmed the readdir-failure path doesn't throw) confirmed in list-get.ts. FROZEN_WHEN_STARTED literal (server task-editability.ts + client mirror pointer) confirmed untouched. spec.md's FR-01.08/FR-01.09 edits (read at .shipwright/planning/01-adopted/spec.md:255-275) match the iterate spec's Spec Impact section exactly, including the corrected 6/7 field-count split and CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION=4 fix. File list matches the mini-plan's plan exactly; no scope creep, no UI surface added, no tag index built. One non-blocking note for the code-reviewer stage: the mini-plan's file list claims the new Playwright spec drives AC8b, but the actual spec.ts omits that case (and the null/non-string sub-cases of AC3/AC4) — immaterial to the AC verdict since the vitest suite covers all of them completely. Code-reviewer may proceed.
